item.title: Forgiveness, Freedom, and Obedience to Christ
item.description: Doreen Virtue teaches from Matthew 6:14–15 on why Jesus commands forgiveness, how believers walk in obedience, and how Christ grants freedom from bitterness.

item.title: Psalm 120, Peace in a World of Lies
item.description: In this episode, Dave Jenkins teaches through Psalm 120 and explores truth, distress, conflict, and peace in a world filled with deceit. This message encourages believers to cry out to God, trust His character, and walk as pilgrims in a hostile age.

item.title: Ezra Overview Conclusion, From Ruin to Renewal and God’s Faithful Restoration December 5, 2025
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, we conclude our journey through the book of Ezra. From exile to restoration and from ruin to renewal, this devotional highlights the major themes of Ezra including the sovereignty of God, repentance, holiness, and the centrality of Scripture. Dave Jenkins explores how Ezra ultimately points us to Jesus Christ, our true and greater Restorer.

item.title: Rebuilding Walls and Hearts, A Christ-Centered Overview of Nehemiah
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, we begin a new journey through the book of Nehemiah. We explore the background, structure, themes, and how the book points us to Christ as the true Restorer who rebuilds what is broken.

item.title: The Collapse of Biblical Authority: Why So Many Christians No Longer Trust the Bible
item.description: Biblical authority is collapsing in the modern church. Dave examines recent statistics, what they reveal about Christians today, and why Scripture matters.
